Subagent orchestration gate
Result: use-subagent-orchestrator
Reason: Strong orchestration signals detected.

Why parallel:
- independent track 1: map legacy-plugin references and documentation paths with files and remaining references
- independent track 2: review documentation, QA consistency, and setup verification with mismatches and coverage gaps
Blockers checked: explicit user opt-out, child-agent recursion, strict sequential dependencies, conflicting writes, workspace-write dirty-state isolation, external side effects, privacy/tool limits, unbounded broad agent tasks.
Read-only agents must report whether findings depend on uncommitted changes.
Subagents:
- so_mapper
  mode: read-only
  scope: legacy-plugin references and documentation paths
  expected output: files and remaining references
  constraints: no recursive fan-out
- so_reviewer
  mode: read-only
  scope: documentation and QA consistency
  expected output: material mismatches only
  constraints: no recursive fan-out
- so_tester
  mode: read-only
  scope: setup verification
  expected output: commands and coverage gaps
  constraints: no recursive fan-out
